items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: About a month ago, she pointed to Daddy, she says, Kid Ory. And then she pointed in where I was, I was in my bedroom at the time, she says, Kid Mommy.

ctx.x: Yeah, music. He told me, not worry about my part, but I played what he wrote for me and he, I know some of them, they don't sound like you, they forget to turn that over. Uh-huh. But you guys played what you see. So some of them. He told Simmy too, you know. Uh-huh. To go for himself. Yeah. Spot, you know. He told me no way about it. I can't write your music. Uh-huh. Were those silk shirts white colored or? Different colored. Most they colored, you know, striped. Bright colored? Yeah. Yeah. One rang the other day…

An even funnier one than that that she pulled. About a month ago, she pointed to Daddy, she says, Kid Ory. And then she pointed in where I was, I was in my bedroom at the time, she says, Kid Mommy. And she pointed her side and says, Kid me. Don't kid me. Kid did me.
